listing.description_html:
The fun way to learn to write letters and numbers!

This tracing workbook takes preschoolers from first pencil lines to writing every letter and number. Kids start with easy warm up pages, then trace each letter A to Z in uppercase and lowercase, and finish with numbers 0 to 10.

  • Warm up pages for pencil control: lines, zig zags, waves and loops
  • A to Z in uppercase and lowercase with dotted letters to trace
  • Numbers 0 to 10
  • Big letters to color on every page
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages with clear handwriting lines

Perfect for Pre K, kindergarten and homeschool. Add it to your cart today!
